_note: Physics-based pools on the art grid (src/vfx/splat_shape.gd shape, src/vfx/pool_paint.gd drawing). A pool runs out from where it lands along its flight; walls and solid props stop it and its volume runs on along them (a corner fills, the open floor gets a stretched blot). squash = how flat it lies (the floor seen at a slant); momentum 0..1 = how far it keeps sliding along its flight; spread_time = s it takes to run out to its rim; edge_time = s its rim goes before its middle at the end; rebake_hz = how often a changing pool is shaded again at most; anim_hz = the frame rate of living materials (fire, lava). materials: style (liquid, void, ice, fire, lava), droplets = drops a thrown splat flings ahead, bubbles = bubbles at a time, ramp = opaque colours by role (spec specular, hi highlight and north rim, lite light swirls, body, shade, deep south row and lip, outline). Materials are opaque (no alpha); see production/qa/evidence/crypt-vfx-review.
